measure_description: Manually measured with the IKEA GRILLPLATS smart plug (Strommessung Schreibtisch) via Home Assistant. OpenWrt-based Multy M1 (WSM20) mesh node in router mode with both WiFi bands enabled (2.4 GHz + 5 GHz), 4 Ethernet clients connected, iPerf3 speed test performed on 5 GHz WiFi. Measured over ~2.5 hours with 45+ samples at 10-minute intervals; power range 4.9–8.7 W, average ~5.0 W. The 8.7 W peak was recorded during the 5 GHz iPerf3 speed test with 4 Ethernet clients active; sustained idle power ≈ 5.0 W. Manufacturer rated power 15 W per Zyxel specifications (12 V DC / 1.5 A PSU).
name: Multy M1 (OpenWrt)
